Synopsis:
Windmill mindflayer asks player to bring it a corpse to feed on.Speaker 3 is an optional non-illithid player that will briefly be pointed out as potential food in the conversation.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_Windmill_Mindflayer.json: A lone illithid is holed up at the windmill and is asking the player to bring it a corpse to feed on. It can sense a trace of illithid power on the player — enough to mark them as allied or touched by its kind — but will only deal with someone who actually carries an illithid passenger. Off-screen there is therefore a companion or charge who bears that illithid influence (the person the player "follows") whom the mind flayer wants brought to it, likely as the corpse it intends to consume. The player in these excerpts is non‑illithid and may act as intermediary or turn hostile; an optional third party can be briefly pointed out as potential food during the exchange.
- Astarion_Recruitment.json: Following a trail of whispered ADs ('Psst. Over here!' 'Come on, before it's too late!') we find a pale elf, hunched down near some long grass. He insists an intellect devourer (brain monster with legs) is hiding there, trying to cajole you to look and kill it. If you approach the grass, a boar bursts out - it was a distraction while Astarion got behind you. He's on edge, but pleased to have the jump on you. He holds a blade to your throat while demanding you tell him what happened on the ship. After a mind meld (vision where he sees a glimpse of your past) you can convince him that you're both victims and should work together to find an answer. Once he realises you're not a threat his tone changes from threatening to charming.
- UND_MyconidCircle_SocietyOfBrilliance_Scholar.json: The player meets Blurg, a hobgoblin (deep orc) member of the Society of Brilliance, a group of intelligent, neutral monsters working to improve the Underdark. He talks about his research and, if the tadpole is mentioned, brings his mind flayer friend Omeluum to talk to the player. The player can either agree to the mind flayer's help or attack.
- WYR_Windmill_Mindflayer_AskPlayerForHelp.json: When the player convinces the mind flayer to go hunt, and the mind flayer gets into combat (not according to plan), and the mind flayer sees the player, on his turn he will ask for help.
- UND_MyconidSovereign.json: Main dialogue with creepy myconid sovereign. He wants you to kill some duergar that are left from when they attacked these mushroom creatures. Myconids are part of a "circle", kind of a hive mind. They speak in visions, with music - all telepathically. This should be otherworldly and slightly disturbing.

- Mind Flayer: ...what are you? What am I sensing? || [context] NodeContext: Curious (node 37)
- Mind Flayer: Ah, the trace of illithid power. There is none in your body, but you have been close to it. Touched by it. (node 113)
- Mind Flayer: You are an ally of my people. A servant, perhaps? (node 33)
- Player: What are you doing here? (node 111)
- Mind Flayer: I require an equal: one with the same power flowing through their form. (node 72)
- Mind Flayer: Return with the one you follow - I will speak to them and no other. (node 17)
- Player: Attack. (node 81)
